a: Teardown stops the redraw watch before it cancels the gestures, so an in-flight overlay is never cleared
`lift` drops a stopped keyup only from `downKeys`; held-key gestures and keymap leaders stay engaged
Modifier changes dispatch a hover on whichever view was routed last, not on the view under the pointer
b: The keymap's `unbound` fallback is frozen at render time while every other gesture setting is read live
A drop's preview runs with different params than the drop itself: no `viewId` and no modifier roles
An OS drop no binding takes still has its default prevented
A UI-driven handle on a dispatcher not yet watched never triggers a redraw
